title: AI's Replication Crisis Solution: VERITAS Is Good, But We're Missing the Point
angle: While VERITAS offers an impressive AI-powered framework for automating scientific replication, we argue that the real challenge isn't just replication, but incentivizing transparent, reproducible science from the outset. VERITAS is a band-aid on a deeper systemic issue.
rationale: This story presents a strong opportunity for a nuanced take on the broader implications of AI in scientific research, moving beyond the technical achievement to the ethical and systemic challenges.
